{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect basic info
df.info()

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nCustomer age -1 count:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("\nFirst 5 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:", df['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for QA orders
print("\nRevenue values of 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
